facts.fact: FAO published a technical report using remote sensing, with biomass productivity, agricultural indices, rainfall data and high-resolution imagery, to assess Sudan's cultivated cropland for the June-October 2024 summer season, finding 19,148,190 hectares, 6.4 percent above the 2018-2022 baseline.
facts.system: FAO remote sensing assessment of cultivated cropland in the Sudan
